Ordinance No. 2026-1806 Adopted 6/9/26 AN ORDINANCE OF THE TOWN COMMISSION OF THE TOWN OF SURFSIDE, FLORIDA AMENDING ARTICLE VI "NOMINATIONS AND ELECTIONS" SECTION 101. "QUALIFYING FOR ELECTED OFFICE" OF THE TOWN CHARTER PURSUANT TO SECTIONS 100.3605(2) AND 166.021(4), FLORIDA STATUTES, WITH LIMITED APPLICABILITY TO DELETE QUALIFYING DATES RELATING TO THE TOWN'S MARCH 19, 2024 GENERAL ELECTION; REPEALING SEC. 26-14. – "CHANGE IN QUALIFYING DATES FOR THE MARCH 19, 2024 GENERAL ELECTION" OF CHAPTER 26 "ELECTIONS" OF THE TOWN CODE; AMENDING CHAPTER 26 OF THE TOWN CODE "ELECTIONS" BY CREATING SEC. 26-15 "QUALIFYING PERIODS FOR GENERAL ELECTION"; PROVIDING FOR CODIFICATION AND INCLUSION IN THE CHARTER AND CODE; PROVIDING FOR SEVERABILITY; PROVIDING FOR NOTIFICATION TO THE MIAMI-DADE COUNTY SUPERVISOR OF ELECTIONS; PROVIDING FOR CONFLICTS; AND PROVIDING FOR AN EFFECTIVE DATE.

Resolution No. 2026-3480 Adopted 1/13/26 A RESOLUTION OF THE TOWN COMMISSION OF THE TOWN OF SURFSIDE, FLORIDA, CALLING FOR A TOWN OF SURFSIDE SPECIAL ELECTION TO BE HELD ON MARCH 17, 2026, FOR THE PURPOSE OF SUBMITTING TO THE ELECTORATE ONE BALLOT QUESTION CONTAINING PROPOSED AMENDMENTS TO THE TOWN CHARTER: AT ARTICLE VI - "NOMINATIONS AND ELECTIONS", SECTION 105. - "GENERAL AND SPECIAL ELECTIONS OF COMMISSION MEMBERS," TO CHANGE THE GENERAL ELECTION DATE FROM THE THIRD TUESDAY IN MARCH TO THE FIRST TUESDAY IN NOVEMBER, EXTENDING ONE-TIME ONLY, THE TERMS OF OFFICIALS ELECTED IN 2026 TO NOVEMBER 2028; PROVIDING REQUISITE BALLOT LANGUAGE AND CHARTER AMENDMENT TEXT FOR SUBMISSION TO THE ELECTORATE; PROVIDING FOR THE TOWN CLERK TO UTILIZE THE SERVICES OF THE MIAMI-DADE COUNTY SUPERVISOR OF ELECTIONS FOR THE SPECIAL ELECTION; PROVIDING FOR AUTHORIZATION; AND PROVIDING FOR AN EFFECTIVE DATE.
